_comment: Clip Machine settings. Copy to machine_config.json (setup does it for you). The machine re-reads it every run.
_gpu_mode_help: auto = heavy work only when no game is running (light_games.txt are ignored); on = always allowed; off = never
_platforms_help: Everything starts OFF. Turn a platform on once its keys are in. youtube review_mode=true (after the audit): uploads stay private so you check them and hit publish yourself. audited=false: YouTube uploads stay PRIVATE and TikTok goes to your INBOX (you tap post). Flip to true only after the audit is approved.
_sources_help: The bot works through your WHOLE channel: a few videos downloaded at a time, used-up ones deleted to save space.
_ids_help: Leave the IDs blank to use the ones in profile.json. ntfy_topic is created for you (a random private phone-alert channel).
